ttr__mtt.scope: The original fixed-model man-runs construction, plus a separate zero-arity ptype/binary-meet witness contract; neither is the full TTR or MTT framework.
ttr__mtt.observations: Inhabitation, carrier-witness identity and satisfaction under explicitly compatible changes of assignment. Atomic inhabitation agreement alone can fail at meet.
ttr__mtt.representation_choices: The original bridge existentially erases predicate witnesses. The new contract instead adds a shared carrier and model-indexed predicates, realized with strong Sigma in MTT/Ranta; external TTR codes and assignments are not identified with their extensions or MTT judgments.
ttr__mtt.direction: The original map preserves inhabitation, not record identity. The new fragment maps preserve carrier witnesses; independent packages recover a shared package exactly on the aligned image. Model transport is conditional on explicit preservation/reflection assumptions.
ttr__mtt.limitations: The original counterexample rules out an inverse of this subject projection only. The new contract covers zero-arity ptypes and binary meet on fixed domains, not dependent records, varying Type_M or whole-theory satisfaction. Reflection of target inhabitation additionally requires surjectivity. No theory-level relation is approved.

mtt__ranta.scope: Selected noun types, quantifiers, intersective adjectives and donkey constructions in the two encodings. A separate shared-carrier contract also compares strong packages with Type-valued fibres.
mtt__ranta.observations: Specified sentence meanings and witness-bearing versus proposition-valued existential constructions.
mtt__ranta.representation_choices: Both encodings provide strong Sigma witnesses. The weak existential comparison uses inhabitation; explicit lifts and subset representations remain relevant.
mtt__ranta.direction: Some constructions agree directly; others have named directional maps. No translation of the entire theories is specified.
mtt__ranta.limitations: Agreement of selected constructors does not settle coercive subtyping, generation, discourse progression or the full source theories. The added witness contract deliberately supplies a common carrier and predicates; agreement under that re-encoding is not native architectural equivalence.

mtt__dts.scope: Quantifiers over induced image predicates, negative predication and a Prop-valued donkey fragment.
mtt__dts.observations: The stated quantified propositions and translated donkey reading.
mtt__dts.representation_choices: Noun types and entity predicates are connected by explicit image and Sigma constructions; they are not assumed identical.
mtt__dts.direction: Selected equivalences use the specified lifting or noun/context translation; no unrestricted calculus inclusion is claimed.
mtt__dts.limitations: The results do not cover arbitrary Type-valued DTS predicates, the full heterogeneous IS calculus or general dependent proof search.

ranta__dts.scope: Predicate-based noun/context representations, the canonical donkey reading and selected discourse constructions.
ranta__dts.observations: Canonical and strong donkey readings; round trips of the explicitly represented contexts.
ranta__dts.representation_choices: DTS entity predicates become evidence-bearing Sigma noun types. Context reassociation and projection search are explicit.
ranta__dts.direction: There are maps between the selected context representations; their round trips do not constitute an equivalence of whole calculi.
ranta__dts.limitations: The source-specific resolution comparison is bounded. General proof search, model correspondence and theory-wide conservativity remain unassessed.

ptq__lambek.scope: Four selected proper-name, quantifier and type-raising constructions.
ptq__lambek.observations: Equality of the computed denotations in the specified fragment.
ptq__lambek.representation_choices: Compare Lambek derivations under the chosen semantic interpretation with the corresponding PTQ meanings.
ptq__lambek.direction: The selected Lambek derivations compute the displayed PTQ meanings; this is not a bidirectional translation of grammars.
ptq__lambek.limitations: These equalities do not identify grammatical architecture, derivation structure, scope mechanisms or intensional semantics.

ptq__mtt.scope: Selected quantifiers and generalized-quantifier conservativity after noun re-encoding.
ptq__mtt.observations: Truth conditions of the translated quantified propositions.
ptq__mtt.representation_choices: Predicates over an entity domain are re-encoded as noun types. The comparison depends on this chosen representation.
ptq__mtt.direction: The named quantifier results are equivalences for translated inputs, not a general preservation-and-reflection theorem for both theories.
ptq__mtt.limitations: The old selection-restriction grade is a prose annotation, not a mechanized impossibility result. GQ conservativity is not conservative interpretation of an entire theory.

ptq__kratzer.scope: The displayed modal clauses, including the empty-background case and selected modal laws.
ptq__kratzer.observations: Necessity, possibility and their relationships under the stated background conditions.
ptq__kratzer.representation_choices: Kratzer's conversational-background parameter is explicit. Empty-background agreement does not erase context-dependent distinctions.
ptq__kratzer.direction: A special-case relationship and selected laws are recorded; no whole-framework translation is assessed.
ptq__kratzer.limitations: The legacy file carries its own assumptions. Ordering sources and the full intensional systems are not covered by the special-case result.

ptq__barwise_cooper.scope: Selected generalized-quantifier definitions and conservativity/monotonicity instances.
ptq__barwise_cooper.observations: The displayed quantifier propositions and their algebraic properties.
ptq__barwise_cooper.representation_choices: Compare the specified extensional generalized-quantifier forms. The listed supporting file is not by itself a cross-theory translation.
ptq__barwise_cooper.direction: Matching definitions and separate instances are recorded; no general translation between the complete accounts is specified.
ptq__barwise_cooper.limitations: Witness-set/definability results are not formalized in this comparison. The legacy Barwise-Cooper record retains parameters and classical assumptions.

lambek__discocat.scope: Selected sentence derivations and their interpretations in Lambek and pregroup encodings.
lambek__discocat.observations: The examples named in the historical record; no mechanized cross-framework preservation theorem is supplied.
lambek__discocat.representation_choices: Sequent derivations and pregroup reductions use different proof structures; proposition-valued and vector-valued interpretations require an explicit comparison.
lambek__discocat.direction: No Coq bridge yet. The Lambek-to-pregroup translation is proposed work, not a verified edge.
lambek__discocat.limitations: The old grade 3 annotations are not evidence of a proved mediated translation. Implementing a bridge would not automatically establish equivalence or justify a higher score.
